title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta21

## Prepare the integration for a lighter future Map Card

This beta adds an additive, integration-owned prepared render model. The current
Map Card remains unchanged; the purpose of this release is to field-test the
backend preparation and diagnostics before switching frontend rendering paths.

### Static map preparation

- Precompute style-independent SVG paths for zones, Off-limit, VF-off, Channels,
  Gate areas and Custom Areas.
- Precompute bounds and zone centroids.
- Publish both Gate-area-inclusive and Gate-area-exclusive layouts using the
  current card's 1000 x 1000 / 5% padding transform.
- Include station metadata, map metadata and normalized georeference.
- Keep colors, opacity, layer visibility, labels, interaction, zoom/pan and
  mower artwork in the frontend.

### Live route preparation

- Reuse the integration's authoritative `trail_segments` result and convert it
  to compact SVG-ready paths.
- Coalesce active updates and build at most once every two seconds.
- Do not add another trail/cycle/reset resolver.

### One discovery contract

The new ready-only manifest:

`/api/navimower/map/{entry_id}?render_model_manifest=1`

links the prepared static/live resources together with the existing:

- per-zone current-cycle SVG artifact manifest;
- retained History index;
- completed-session render archive.

Prepared resources are content-addressed, authenticated, ETag-aware and retain
the latest two ids for safe in-flight requests.

### Multi-mower readiness

Frontend/Site metadata now advertises the prepared-render and current-cycle
manifest paths per mower, so a future multi-mower card can discover prepared
resources without first downloading the legacy full map payload.

### Diagnostics before frontend adoption

Add cached-only `prepared_render_model` diagnostics with readiness, geometry
parity, build latency, resource sizes, publication/build/coalescing counters and
separate static/live failures.

Also add `session_render_archive` diagnostics for the existing completed
History render cache.

The intended validation sequence is: install beta21, let it run through idle and
mowing states, download diagnostics, verify the prepared backend is stable and
cheap, and only then decide whether the Map Card should consume the new
contract.

No existing Map Card rendering, mower control, ZoneLedger, VendorTrailStore,
progress, schedule or reset semantics are changed.
